description: T05 hover forecast (design guidelines §7). Fixture audit_383_battleshock_shoot, P1 Custodes shooting. A: SELECT_SHOOTER the Caladius Grav-tank (BS 2+ guns); TerrainManager.unit_has_cover_11e confirms Boyz E has the benefit of cover from it. B: the task's seam ShootingController.test_hover_target_id = U_BOYZ_E builds current_hover_forecast through RulesEngine.preview_attack: bs == 3 (2+ worsened by cover, 11e 13.08; also recomputed from the weapon profile), expected_wounds > 0, and the HoverForecast card (/root/Main/ShootingController/HoverForecast) is visible with its shield-icon cover row 'Benefit of cover: BS 2+ → 3+', fully on screen; pixel_diff of the card's rect against the no-hover frame. C: real mouse hovers move between the Battlewagon (T12) and Boyz E (T5) and the numbers follow; once Main's TokenHoverTooltip stats card opens, the forecast card does not overlap it. D: hovering the HUD, then empty board, clears the forecast (null) and hides the card; the card's rect matches the no-hover frame again. E: the Contemptor-Achillus with its twin adrathic destructor row selected: the card describes the selected weapon, BS 2+ and 0.83 hits vs Boyz E in the open, BS 3+ and 0.67 hits plus the cover row vs Kommandos H in cover.

steps.comment: Before: nothing hovered, so no forecast and no card.

steps.script:
var card = tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/ShootingController/HoverForecast")
return card == null or not card.visible

steps.comment: Independent evidence Boyz E has the benefit of cover: the 11e terrain module (13.08) says so for the Caladius's own model, without going through the forecast.
ShootingController.test_hover_target_id runs the production hover path (_set_hover_target) anchored at the unit's on-screen centre.
Tier A: BS 2+ guns vs a target with the benefit of cover = BS 3+ (11e 13.08 worsens BS by 1).
The same expectation computed from the fixture data: the chosen weapon's profile BS plus the one cover step.
Cover icon row with the BS change it causes.
Title is weapon -> target; the profile row shows the cover-worsened BS.
Card fully inside the viewport (not clipped).
Not clipped at the viewport edges: anchored at each corner (the card's own move_to_anchor, as a cursor there would), it flips to stay fully on screen. Then back to Boyz E.
Numbers follow the hover: the Battlewagon's T12 replaces the Boyz' T5.
Let Main's 0.55 s dwell open the TokenHoverTooltip stats card under the cursor.
The forecast card steers clear of the stats card and stays on screen.
Over the HUD the board underneath is not what the player points at.
The selected weapon row is the one described.
Boyz E is in the open for the Contemptor: BS 2+ unchanged.
Kommandos H has the benefit of cover: the same gun needs 3+.
